local function ease(p106: number) -- Line: 215

local function poseAt(p107: table, p108: number) -- Line: 216
    local p = p107[#p107].p;
    local r = p107[#p107].r;

    if p108 <= p107[1].t then
        p = p107[1].p;
        r = p107[1].r;
    else
        for i = 1, #p107 - 1 do
            local v109 = p107[i];
            local v110 = p107[i + 1];

            if p108 <= v110.t then
                local v111 = (p108 - v109.t) / math.max(v110.t - v109.t, 0.001);
                local math_clamp_ret = math.clamp(v111, 0, 1);
                local v112 = math_clamp_ret * math_clamp_ret * (3 - math_clamp_ret * 2);
                p = v109.p:Lerp(v110.p, v112);
                r = v109.r:Lerp(v110.r, v112);
                break;
            end;

            local _ = i;
        end;
    end;

    return CFrame.new(p) * CFrame.Angles(r.X, r.Y, r.Z);
end;
